translations.web: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.
translations.bsb: And He said to me, “Prophesy concerning these bones and tell them, ‘Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!
translations.kjv: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
translations.asv: Again he said unto me, Prophesy over these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of Jehovah.
